shortDescription: Retrieve files from SFTP server to where Ansible runs

options.name: host
options.description: The IP address or hostname of source SFTP server.

options.name: host_key_algorithms
options.description: List of allowed host key algorithms. If not specified, Paramiko's default algorithms will be used. Supports legacy algorithms like 'ssh-dss' for older servers.

options.name: local_path
options.description: The local destination directory or file name, directory names must end with '/'.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for the connection. Required if private_key is not provided.

options.name: port
options.description: The port of source SFTP server.

options.name: private_key
options.description: Path to private key file for SSH key authentication. Required if password is not provided.

options.name: private_key_passphrase
options.description: Passphrase for encrypted private key file.

options.name: remote_path
options.description: The path to the source file or directory or glob pattern on the remote server.
